scientific_choices.rationale: Apply the existing selected two-head model's kernel map to each new text mask; keep its kernel threshold and watershed weights. No segmentation is rerun. This separates the effect of crop localization from changing text foreground, and does not claim a jointly trained model.

The coherent-vote v2 model is already trained100 epochs and selected at84 by its declared held-out loss. Reuse the normalized256 offset outputs and verify their exact source/checkpoint/split/GT alignment.
Use the same global consensus parameters and disabled growth as TRC-001; only the offset checkpoint changes. Keep selected and common0.50 policies separate with no OCR-driven reselection.

Reuse complete hash-qualified crop/PARSeq results from TRC-001 and earlier studies, replay16 exact RGB crops, and recognize only new crops on CPU FP32/batch8. No new trained network or simultaneous GPU residency.
Frozen pretrained cues transferred between models can fail; benefit on reused TRAIN holdout does not establish official TEST or strict paper reproduction.
